meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会给项目添加一个只读的网页仪表盘。这个仪表盘能读取命令行工具(如 NanoClaw 的 ncl)返回的 JSON 数据,自动生成标签页和表格,并显示消息活动、日志和文件内容。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求添加 clidash 只读仪表盘时触发。

say.text: 请帮我添加 clidash,并配置连接 NanoClaw 的 ncl 命令行。
say.note: Claude 会复制工具目录并生成配置文件。

say.text: 给 clidash 增加 docker 作为第二个数据源。
say.note: 它会用配置里的 docker 示例添加新标签页。

say.text: 把 clidash 的监听地址改成私有 IP,方便局域网访问。
say.note: 它会在启动命令中设置 BIND 环境变量。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds a read-only web dashboard to your project. It reads JSON from command-line tools (e.g., NanoClaw's ncl), auto-generates tabs and tables, and shows message activity, logs, and file contents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks to add or install the clidash read-only dashboard.

say_en.text: Please add clidash and configure it to connect to NanoClaw's ncl CLI.
say_en.note: Claude copies the tool directory and creates the config file.

say_en.text: Add docker as a second data source for clidash.
say_en.note: It adds a new tab using the docker example from config.

say_en.text: Change clidash's bind address to a private IP for LAN access.
say_en.note: It sets the BIND environment variable in the startup command.
